source.author: verg
source.text: O patria, O divom domus Ilium, et incluta bello moenia Dardanidum, quater ipso in limine portae substitit, atque utero sonitum quater arma dedere:
source.text_original: O patria, O divom domus Ilium, et incluta bello / moenia Dardanidum, quater ipso in limine portae / substitit, atque utero sonitum quater arma dedere: /
source.text_english: O homeland, O Ilium, house of the gods, and walls of the Dardanians, renowned in war, four times he halted on the very threshold of the gate, and four times the weapons gave forth a sound from within his womb:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: o domus, o freti nequiquam prole penates.
reuse.text_original: o domus, o freti nequiquam prole penates.
reuse.text_english: O house, O household gods, vainly relied on by a doomed offspring.
